newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Taiwan's E-Sun Commercial Bank sets US$60 mln FRCD.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan's E-Sun Commercial Bank sets US$60 mln FRCD.

text.p: E-Sun Commercial Bank Offshore Banking Branch's US$60 million floating rate certificate of deposit issue is now in general syndication, bankers said.
They said the facility has a final maturity of three years. It pays a coupon of 19 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate.
Fees are 18 basis points for lead managers committing US$6 million, 16 basis points for managers committing US$4-6 million, and 14 basis points for co-managers committing US$2-4 million.
Citicorp is the mandated arranger, bankers noted.
Taiwan's E-Sun Commercial Bank is rated Baa1 by Moody's Investors Service.
Commerz East Asia and Tokyo-Mitsubishi Bank are senior co-arrangers.
First Chicago Bank is the co-arranger.
